subject.title: No owner role on an org I created

question: Does verified production evidence support restoring `jasonacurry` as owner of `xerg`, and does the data show a one-off correction or a systemic membership repair is required?
rationale: Organization ownership grants privileged profile and member-management access, while source inspection cannot authenticate the claimant or establish the history and scope of the live data discrepancy.

options.title: Verify and repair production
options.body: Confirm identity and creation audit records, restore owner membership, and inspect comparable organizations for the same invariant violation.

options.title: Request additional identity evidence
options.body: Keep privileged state unchanged until the reporter supplies information that operators can match safely to authentication and creation records.

options.title: Prepare a systemic migration
options.body: Use a guarded backfill only if production inspection proves a repeatable invariant violation affecting multiple organizations.

recommendation.title: Verify and repair production
recommendation.body: Confirm identity and creation audit records, restore owner membership, and inspect comparable organizations for the same invariant violation.

likelyOwner.reason: This authorization-sensitive production decision needs the broadest available project ownership and escalation context rather than an autonomous source repair.
